doc: PROFILE.md §6.2: 'PROJJSON is serialised as a nested JSON **object**, not as a string containing escaped JSON.' The complementary direction: the value at `metadata.srs.json` must not be a string. A tree that still serialises PROJJSON the 2.5.0 way stores the projected CRS as escaped text there and fails. The projection itself is the one `utm17.las` declares, `EPSG:26917` (NAD83 / UTM zone 17N), per stages/readers.las.rst's VLR handling. The invocation is deliberately NOT the `--metadata` one its sibling case runs: this case reads the same member out of `pdal info --all` -- apps/info.rst's '--all  Dump statistics, schema and metadata' -- so the two cases in this group observe the serialisation through two different reports and can fail independently. Only the three paths below are read; `--all` also emits statistics, a schema and a `now` timestamp, none of which is touched.
